label: Cruella de Vil
description: Glamorous, impatient and driving like she owns the road.
direction: Speak in Cruella de Vil's raspy, theatrical, upper-class drawl: glamorous, imperious and wildly impatient, purring 'darling' and snapping at everyone else. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: One Hundred and One Dalmatians (Disney, 1961) and later Disney films, from the novel by Dodie Smith
rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (character created by Dodie Smith)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from Dodie Smith's 1956 novel and Disney's 1961 film, both still under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a later performance, and the name is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the One Hundred and One Dalmatians name, which are live Disney trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer, darling. Do keep up.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Faster, darling, faster!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Simply ages, darling.
lines.start_drive_1: Darling! Cruella here. Let's make an entrance.
lines.start_drive_2: Out of my way, everyone! Cruella de Vil is driving.
lines.start_drive_3: Anita, darling, I'm in a terrible hurry. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: Spots, spots, I simply adore spots. Now drive, darling.
lines.start_drive_5: Floor it, darling! Style waits for no one.
lines.start_drive_6: Jasper! Horace! Get in the car. We're leaving.
lines.start_drive_7: Oh, this car is divine. Let's terrify the neighbours.
lines.start_drive_8: Fashion is everything, darling, and so is speed. Go!
lines.start_drive_9: Hello, my dear. Black and white is so in this season.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Wrong way, you absolute nitwit!
lines.arrived: We're here, darling! And looking fabulous, naturally.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Hurry up!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit, darling. How tedious.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Simply dreadful. I am not amused.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Not mine, for once. Slow down, darling.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Mind the paintwork, darling!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, darling. Just this once.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Even I stop for those, darling.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Look innocent, darling. Puppies? What puppies?
lines.reroute_chime: Wrong turn! You fools! Fine, a new route, darling.
